heroSummary: Kent School District began the 2025–26 year on Wednesday, August 27, 2025. Kindergarten started September 2, preschool started September 9, and the two-hour Wednesday early-release routine began September 3. The scheduled K–12 last day was June 18, 2026, with a three-hour early release; ECSE ended June 11.
calendarNotes: KSD's one-page calendar uses multiple release schedules. Purple Wednesdays are two-hour early releases for all schools. Elementary conference weeks use three-hour early dismissals for elementary schools only, November 25 uses a three-hour secondary dismissal, and the last day uses a three-hour early release for all schools. Optional snow dates require district activation.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Kent School District start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: The general student calendar started Wednesday, August 27, 2025. Kindergarten started September 2, and preschool started September 9.

calendarFaqs.q: Did Kent schools release early every Wednesday in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: The calendar marks a two-hour early release for all schools on Wednesdays beginning September 3. Closures and breaks override the routine; families should confirm exact bell and bus times with their school.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Kent School District Winter Break in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break ran December 22, 2025, through January 2, 2026. Students returned Monday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: How did KSD conference dismissals work in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Elementary schools dismissed three hours early October 13–17 and February 9–13. Secondary schools dismissed three hours early for conferences on November 25.

calendarFaqs.q: Were April 17 and May 22 automatic school days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. KSD listed April 17 first and May 22 second as optional snow make-up days. Additional make-up time could occur after June 18 if district cancellations required it.

calendarFaqs.q: When was the ECSE last day in Kent?
calendarFaqs.a: The ECSE last day was June 11, 2026. The general K–12 calendar continued through June 18, which was a three-hour early-release day for all schools.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can families find translated KSD calendars?
calendarFaqs.a: The official KSD Student Calendar page lists 2025–26 copies in Persian, Punjabi, Spanish, Ukrainian, and Vietnamese. Use the district page for the maintained language files.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 7, 2026, against the official KSD Student Calendar page, document library, and complete one-page 2025–26 Student Calendar PDF.
sourceReviewDetails: We verified the 180-day monthly total, general school opening, kindergarten and preschool starts, recurring Wednesday early release, grade-specific conference dismissals, quarter and semester endings, no-school dates, breaks, ECSE ending, optional snow dates, and K–12 last day.

The calendar's color key distinguishes the two-hour all-school Wednesday schedule, yellow elementary conference dismissals, the orange secondary conference dismissal, and the blue three-hour all-school last-day release.
Optional snow dates are conditional and ordered. The downloadable calendar does not predict whether KSD will activate them or how many June days might be added.
The official Student Calendar page lists multiple 2025–26 language copies and directs families to school websites or the KSD app for school-specific events.
